run_merge_traj: run the merge_traj script on a directory of adsorbate relaxation runs to merge checkpoints into full trajectories
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a ZIP archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_vasp_checkpoints: merge VASP relaxation checkpoint vasprun.xml files from multiple zip archives into a single ASE trajectory
review_main: review the main function that loops through adsorbate subdirectories and merges intermediate checkpoints into full trajectories
refactor_extract_file: refactor extract_file to support extracting multiple files from a ZIP archive at once
